purpose: E1 on-device GGUF engine: one CPU-only JNI shared library for jarvis-client (com.jarvis.client.localai.LlamaNative)

llama_cpp.version_evidence: vendor/llama.cpp/CMakeLists.txt: LLAMA_VERSION_MAJOR 0, MINOR 5, PATCH 0, LLAMA_BUILD_IS_DEV ON; llama_version() returns that string at runtime

vendored_from.upstream_commit_note: The vendored snapshot does not record which upstream llama.cpp commit it was taken from. The PrivateLM commit and the tree hash below are the strongest provenance available; the PLAN records the same limitation.

tree_hash.method: sha256 over UTF-8 lines '<path relative to vendor/llama.cpp, forward slashes>\t<sha256 of file bytes>\n', files sorted by full path

what_changed: process-wide globals replaced by one Engine allocated per Java long handle, so unload/destroy are well defined
Flutter plugin entry points replaced by exactly eight com.jarvis.client.localai.LlamaNative JNI functions
cancellation is the TokenSink.stopped() poll checked once per token, not a separate nativeStop() entry point
mtmd/vision, Vulkan, RPC/phone-cluster and runtime backend loading removed (CPU only, one library)
UTF-8 to UTF-16 via NewString(jchar) and UTF-16 to UTF-8 via GetStringChars; a token piece ending mid-code-point is buffered and prepended to the next piece instead of becoming U+FFFD
greedy sampler when temperature <= 0, temp + dist otherwise; seed is LLAMA_DEFAULT_SEED for the stochastic path
per-generation stats [promptTokens, genTokens, genMillis] measured with std::chrono::steady_clock
GGUF pre-flight, batched prompt evaluation and KV-cache prefix reuse kept from the wrapper

ndk.clang: Android (12470979, based on r522817c) clang version 18.0.3 (https://android.googlesource.com/toolchain/llvm-project d8003a456d14a3deb8054cdaa529ffbf02d9b262)

build_configuration.reproduce:
pwsh -NoProfile -File build-native.ps1            # arm64-v8a
pwsh -NoProfile -File build-native.ps1 -Abi x86_64  # optional emulator ABI

cmake_options.BUILD_SHARED_LIBS: OFF - llama/ggml are static archives linked into the single .so
cmake_options.GGML_STATIC: OFF - it would add a bare -static, invalid for Android
cmake_options.GGML_BACKEND_DL: OFF - CPU backend compiled in and registered statically
cmake_options.GGML_OPENMP: OFF - the NDK ships no libomp
cmake_options.GGML_NATIVE: OFF - cross-compiling, never tune for the build host

build_configuration.post_processing: llvm-strip --strip-unneeded on the published copy (the Release build carries 42,764,331 bytes / 40.8 MB of .debug_* sections and symbol tables). The unstripped library remains in build/<abi>/lib/.

static.load_segment_alignment: all 4 LOAD segments in both ABIs are 0x4000 (16384) aligned - Android 15 16 KB page requirement

on_device.device_model: CPH2419 (the owner's phone named in the PLAN)
on_device.method: Java probe classes with the same binary names/signatures as the Kotlin contract (com.jarvis.client.localai.LlamaNative + TokenSink), dexed with d8 and run through app_process; the library was loaded with System.load from /data/local/tmp. The native methods are declared as INSTANCE methods (jobject second argument), the same shape Kotlin's `object LlamaNative` compiles to. No APK and no root required.
on_device.result: PASS (all 15 probe checks, device exit code 0)
checks: nativeLoad(missing file) fails with rc=-4 and a readable nativeLastError
second nativeGenerate on the same prompt (KV-cache prefix reuse) rc=0
Unicode prompt/reply: CJK code points U+5DF4 U+9ECE ... (correct UTF-8 -> UTF-16 conversion)
stopped()=true before the first token cancels with rc=0 and no emits

measurements.config: Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct Q4_K_M, ctx 2048, 4 threads, greedy (temperature 0), CPU

on_device.probe_build_note: javac must be given -encoding UTF-8 (run-probe.ps1 does): the probe contains a Chinese prompt literal and javac's Windows default charset silently compiled it as Latin-1. The first run of the Unicode check failed for that reason, not because of the library; after the fix the same .so passed.

known_limitations: Functional evidence comes from the probe harness, not from the real jarvis-client app. The probe mirrors Kotlin's instance-method calling shape and passed, but the Kotlin LlamaNative/TokenSink integration, R8 keep rules, UI, switch-off default and the idle-unload / 180 s cap policy are the integration lane's work.
The probe's LlamaNative class is a Java stand-in with the same binary name and signatures; the actual Kotlin object, its packaging and R8-minified build were not executed on the phone in this lane.

The library is a baseline arm64-v8a build: ggml's dotprod/fp16/i8mm/SVE feature checks did not enable those paths (no -march or per-CPU-variant backends), so it is portable but not the fastest possible CPU build. 19.92 tokens/s on a 0.5B Q4_K_M (repeat runs 19.66-20.00) is the measured baseline. Runtime CPU variants (PrivateLM's approach) or -march tuning are E3 follow-ups.
The x86_64 library is built and statically checked (8 symbols, 0x4000 alignment) but was not executed: no Android emulator was started in this lane.
Only the owner's CPH2419 on Android 15 was tested; other devices/Android versions are unverified.
No Vulkan/GPU, no RPC/phone-cluster and no mtmd/vision in this build, by design for E1.
The 0.4 GB test GGUF is a local test asset and is not part of the deliverable.
